summary.text: Tameika Isaac Devine is a Democratic member of the South Carolina Senate for District 19 in Richland County.
She was elected in a special election on January 2, 2024, to fill the unexpired term of John L. Scott Jr., who died.

paragraphs.text: Isaac Devine was born in Charlotte, North Carolina, and is an attorney and partner at Jabber & Isaac, PA.
Her official page lists a B.S. from Hampton University in 1994 and a J.D. from the University of South Carolina in 1997.
She served as an at-large Columbia city councilwoman from 2002 to 2021.
Her Senate committees are Corrections and Penology, Family and Veterans' Services, Judiciary and Transportation.
